material_limit_found.finding: After the existing gradient-01 execution, the frozen control history still lists only the prior core and risk followup attempts. Read-only check of that exact control contract continues to return eligible_for_separate_execution. The fixed gradient-01 output path is create-only and blocks overwriting it, but the guard alone cannot detect a new output route for the already completed scientific identity until this run is added to reviewed history and its spent budget recorded.
material_limit_found.actual_evidence: gradient-execution-receipt.json records exit_code 0 and a result manifest; gradient-control-contract.json history.attempts has only history-core-01 and history-risk-followup-01; actual check() returned eligible_for_separate_execution
material_limit_found.needed_control_step: Before any later P2 family execution, root must bind this gradient attempt, terminal receipt and manifest into reviewed history, update followup_used, and read back the revised control result. No automatic atomic reservation exists.

manual_or_outside_boundary: This read-only guard runs only when a caller invokes the new entry; it is not a scheduler, file-system sandbox, global history discovery, or atomic budget counter.
History completeness and scientific identity wording are controller declarations. It cannot identify a semantically duplicate question with changed wording or omitted attempt.

Source qualification status, financial score meaning and original P2 evidence were projected and accepted elsewhere; this guard checks declared publication inequality and frozen bytes, not independent financial truth. The 93376 projected records are all qualified and do not represent all unknown source rows.

The selector column whitelist keeps result columns out of that projection. The already seen diagnostic runner is separately authorized to read the bound stock_weights future_return column; the guard cannot erase agent memory of earlier outcomes.
A process exit code or computed manifest does not by itself mean accepted scientific evidence. The current controller review has result_accepted=false.
review_conclusion: The new runner does call the frozen control before outcome computation and enforces its eligible status. Listed negative conditions are mechanically blocked for the enumerated contract and unit cases. A post-run attempt-history update is required before claiming duplicate-run prevention for subsequent routes.
